afterImage.description: Pathway Power LLC is a U.S. utility-scale solar and battery-storage developer and independent power producer with projects across SPP, MISO and other U.S. power markets. Company and transaction materials describe a multi-gigawatt pipeline spanning 13 states, including the Greenridge hybrid solar-and-storage project in Texas and the Foxtrot battery project in Arkansas. Igneo Infrastructure Partners completed a preferred-equity investment on June 4, 2026 through its North American strategy and discloses joint governance and a board seat; the legal vehicle, ownership percentage and preference economics are not public. Pathway Power Holdings LLC is treated as a same-platform financing issuer, while Greenridge, Foxtrot and other project SPVs remain subordinate assets. Renova's convertible notes had not converted, and Forest Road, Rabobank and AB CarVal were evidenced as lenders rather than current ordinary-equity owners. No later platform sale, Igneo exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
